Name: Nyapu Style Portraits for Sable from Pelican Palette
Author: Howaa
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
[size=3]I really dig little slice of life activities in games, I often reminisce on the comedy club and basketball mini-games in the Urbz for DS and I've wished for similar mechanics in my SDV playthroughs. So I was excited for a mod like Pelican Palette that introduces painting into Stardew~ This mod retextures the NPC packaged with the mod, Sable, the paint shop employee, to be Nyapu-styled.[/size]

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[size=3]This is a file replacement mod! So you'll need to drag my " Pelican Palette" folder into your mods folder to allow my portraits to overwrite the originals, then you're done! [/size]


[b][size=4]Shout outs[/size][/b]
